answer: An identity must be at least 7 epochs old on the glacier ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. Because the age is read from the lantern checkpoint rather than self-declared, the umber audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. Running a farm thus means funding each extra identity through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent pays once and never again. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
